semiconductor_relevance: High — The Shinoda Laboratory at Tokyo Denki University is actively involved in developing advanced deposition systems for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Tokyo Denki University's Shinoda Laboratory focuses on developing a sputter epitaxy system for high-quality compound semiconductor single crystal layers. Their work emphasizes cost-effectiveness and environmental sustainability, contributing significantly to the semiconductor manufacturing process, particularly in deposition techniques.
capabilities: Sputter epitaxy systems for compound semiconductors
Development of GaAs on Silicon, GaN, InP, and SiGe materials
